content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Oklo, Vistra, Opendoor, Intel, GM, Revolution Medicines, Tilray, and More
content.summary: Stocks rose Friday after fresh jobs data showed U.S. unemployment ticked down in December and a potential Supreme Court ruling on tariffs failed to pan out.  Vistra  stock surged 11% and  Oklo  jumped 7.9% after the nuclear energy companies unveiled separate agreements to provide power to  Meta Platforms  in order to support the hyperscaler’s data-center campus in Ohio.  Meta inched up 1.1%.

content.title: Retail stocks slide, Tilray Brands earnings, Mattel downgrade
content.description:
Market Domination Host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma take a closer look at some of the trending tickers during Friday's session.

Retail stocks, like Under Armour (UAA, UA), Kohl's (KSS), and Lululemon (LULU), fell after the US Supreme Court didn't release a final ruling on President Trump's tariff policies that was expected on Friday.

Tilray Brands (TLRY) stock is in focus following the cannabis company's second quarter earnings results.

Goldman downgrades its rating on Mattel stock (MAT) to Neutral.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
